args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks — rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 deploy (error rate 18% across us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rolled back in all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollback verified in all three regions. Note: v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy in staging before promotion. Root cause of v2.3.1 failure still to be investigated.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all production regions, and it's healthy again. I also opened a SEV2 incident.

- **Cause:** The service had been failing health checks since v2.3.1 was deployed, with an 18% error rate in us-east, us-west and eu-west.
- **Rollback:** v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production. All three regions are now running it.
- **Health now:** The service passes health checks, and the error rate is down to 0.2%.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 (SEV2, checkout-api) is open and has paged on-call. It says what failed, what I rolled back and that the rollback succeeded in all three regions. The root cause of the v2.3.1 failure still needs investigating.

v2.3.1 was released to production even though its release candidate (v2.3.1-rc) had already failed in staging. I put this in the incident so the team can look at how that release got through.

content.text: Most recent healthy production release is v2.3.0.
